hitl_conditions: Human involvement depends on interpretable, attributed risk scores and twin outcomes reported in managerial terms; adoption is incremental as data integration and analytics maturity increase, with decisions staying with managers rather than models.
key_finding: Three-layer framework (ML/DL risk scoring, digital-twin scenario testing, performance linkage) on a synthetic MNC panel: Federated GCN gave the best disruption prediction (AUC 0.94); twin scenarios showed cross-border diversity, digitalization and ESG dampened climate-shock losses and cut recovery from eight to five months.

quotes.text: A digital twin was created for each corporation and its subsidiaries, integrating risk predictions, optimization policies, and supply network topology to enable scenario analysis.
A digital twin, a virtual replica with embedded data and models, executes what-if scenarios (e.g., port closure, upstream failure, last-mile congestion) to compare policies under controlled shocks.

quotes.text: A synthetic panel was constructed comprising 50 MNCs, each with 20 subsidiaries (N = 1,000 units), observed monthly from January 2020 to December 2024.
